t: This is Buckingham Palace, the official London residence and administrative headquarters of the monarch. It often stands at the centre of state occasions and royal hospitality, and it has been a focal point for the British people in times of national rejoicing and mourning. Queen Victoria lived here, and so did Edward the Seventh, who was born here and died here. George the Sixth lived here, followed by Queen Elizabeth the Second, whose reign of seventy years was the longest of any British monarch. Prince Philip lived here too. King Charles the Third was born here and lived here.
